name: grid-subgrid-shared-first-baseline
derivation: The13px-high leaf inside the row-subgrid and the29px-high direct item align first baselines in the same inherited parent row. Empty leaf boxes synthesize alphabetic baselines at their bottom border edges,13 and29. The descendant receives a29-13=16px start shim, so both baselines lie at y29 and the auto row is29px tall. The subgrid itself stretches to that row; treating it as an independent baseline group would incorrectly leave its descendant at y0.
